plain: A writer named Graham Hancock, who is known for his books about lost ancient civilisations, told the podcast host Jesse Michels about drinking yage, a plant brew from South America that causes visions. He says that during the experience he sensed a presence, and that this presence was communicating with him. To him, it suggests there may be other minds out there that we can reach this way.
